resourcePolicy.optimizer: disabled to avoid compile-time rewrite amplification
resourcePolicy.matching: VM work is charged across every pattern for a path. Raw regex calls reserve a fair share of the remaining two-million-unit list budget, then divide that reservation by (emitted program units + 2*capture slots + 1)*(subject UTF16 units + 1) before invoking the upstream backtrack budget. Preparation and the full reservation are charged; exhaustion returns an error, never a false match. This is conservative complexity accounting, not an engine instruction counter, and extreme accepted source expressions can fail the explicit native resource bound.
resourcePolicy.compileProof: Excessive flat capture count and nested assertions fail before regex compilation. Nested-plus matching and capture-heavy nested-plus witnesses report explicit exhaustion; the added100/500-empty-capture regression exceeded a five-second subprocess deadline before complexity weighting and the entire18-test suite now completes in0.60s on the recorded host.
